name: jpn-airport-taxi-guide
description: Combined taxi route guides for Tokyo Haneda (RJTT), Narita (RJAA), Osaka Itami (RJOO), Kansai (RJBB), Naha (ROAH) and New Chitose (RJCC): choose an airport, then follow standard arrival and departure taxi routes on a gridded airport map. For flight simulation.
